changeSet.author: alfcheun
changeSet.comment: Backfill shredded metrics from PAYLOAD_JSON for existing rows
changeSet.sql: UPDATE BT.RESULT SET TOTAL_RETURN = (PAYLOAD_JSON -> 'performance' -> 'strategy_metrics' ->> 'Total Return')::NUMERIC, ANNUALIZED_RETURN = (PAYLOAD_JSON -> 'performance' -> 'strategy_metrics' ->> 'Annualized Return')::NUMERIC, SHARPE_RATIO = (PAYLOAD_JSON -> 'performance' -> 'strategy_metrics' ->> 'Sharpe Ratio')::NUMERIC, MAX_DRAWDOWN = (PAYLOAD_JSON -> 'performance' -> 'strategy_metrics' ->> 'Max Drawdown')::NUMERIC, CALMAR_RATIO = (PAYLOAD_JSON -> 'performance' -> 'strategy_metrics' ->> 'Calmar Ratio')::NUMERIC WHERE TOTAL_RETURN IS NULL AND PAYLOAD_JSON -> 'performance' -> 'strategy_metrics' IS NOT NULL;
